text:
alice: Quick heads-up — planning to rollout users.schema.v2 migration in the next change window. Will canary with 5% traffic then ramp.
ben: which window? tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC?
alice: yes — extended window to allow for backfill and any index builds. Target DB shard group 'users-primary'.
chris: will need to pin service versions that touch the users table. I'll open a PR to pin auth/profile/notifications to 1.14.2 for the canary.
dina: agree on pinning. Also we should use short explicit lock timeout and a safe backfill pattern.
chris: listing services to pin: auth-service, profile-service, notif-service. pin duration: 90m (covers canary + ramp + cool-down).
alice: pin duration 90m sounds good. Add rollback note to the PR.
dina: migration SQL will be online-friendly. Example backfill snippet:
```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN legacy_id bigint;
-- backfill in batches below
COMMIT;
```
ben: backfill plan? recommend job queue approach with rate limit to avoid hotspots.
alice: backfill via workers: 8 workers, 50 rows/sec total, stop if p95 latency > 300ms for frontends.
eric-sre: monitoring — I'll add dashboard panels and an alert: users.migration.p95_latency > 300ms for 5m => paged. Also alert on long locks: pg_locks wait > 10s.
migrations-bot: scheduled migration users.schema.v2 for 1769995200 (02:00 UTC) by alice. canary=5%, shards=[s1], pins=[auth:1.14.2,profile:1.14.2,notif:1.14.2]
alice: Deploy/runbook summary: deploy-bot will run canary sequence. Rollback criteria: increase in error rate >1% OR db lock wait >10s OR backfill job failures >3. Rollback action: revert service pins to v1, cancel backfill queue, run schema rollback script.
deploy-bot: canary started on shard s1 at 1769995205; status=IN_PROGRESS
chris: migration tests on staging passed earlier today (smoke + load).
dina: remember to build index CONCURRENTLY or defer if needed: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_legacy_id ON users(legacy_id);
ben: on-call coverage: @eric-sre + @chris on standby for first 90 minutes.
alice: checklist before canary: pins merged, dashboard up, backfill job queued but paused, rollback runbook linked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/migration-rollback
eric-sre: I'll set a temporary SLO override to avoid noisy paging during expected small spikes, but will page on the thresholds we discussed. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary finished on shard s1 at 1769995320; status=SUCCESS
alice: ramping to 20% over next 15m, then to 100% after 1h if metrics remain stable.
chris: schedule unpin: created unpin job at 1769998920 (~1h30m) to revert pins automatically.
ben: capture slow queries during migration: enable pg_stat_statements tagging with tag=migration_users_v2 for queries >500ms.
alice: thanks everyone — I'll post a short release note once we finish the ramp.
eric-sre: watching the dashboard now, will trigger rollback if alerts fire.
